title: Hernshaw Farms USDA Certification Milestone
reason: Hernshaw Farms is described as a certified mushroom farm in West Virginia, setting a precedent in the region.

tasks.task: Outline Hernshaw Farms' achievements and certification.

subtasks.text: Describe Hernshaw Farms' successful renewal of the USDA Mushroom Good Agricultural Practices certification.
Mention Hernshaw Farms' status as the first and only commercially certified mushroom farm in West Virginia.

tasks.task: Discuss Hernshaw Farms' innovative approach to mushroom farming in unexpected locations.

subtasks.text: Note the farm's cultivation of clean food in a former coal mine.
